about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Sambal Goreng Tofu and Long Beans
recipes.summary: Crisp fried tofu and green beans tossed in a sticky sweet chilli and tamarind sambal, a vegan Malaysian side or main.
steps: Fry the tofu in the oil for 6 minutes until golden and crisp, then lift out.
Fry the shallots and garlic in the same oil for 3 minutes until soft.
Add the chilli paste and cook for 4 minutes until the oil rises to the surface.
Stir in the tamarind, sugar and a splash of water and simmer until sticky.
Add the beans and tofu and toss for 4 minutes until the beans are just tender.

recipes.title: Hokkien Mee Prawn Noodle Soup
recipes.summary: A deep prawn-head broth with pork, egg noodles, bean sprouts and fried shallots, rich and sweet with a chilli kick.
steps: Peel the prawns, keeping the heads and shells, and set the meat aside.
Fry the shells and heads in the oil for 5 minutes until bright orange.
Add the garlic, chilli paste, ribs and water and simmer for 45 minutes until the ribs are tender and the broth is red-gold.
Strain and season with soy sauce and white pepper.
Boil the eggs for 8 minutes, cool, peel and halve.
Poach the prawns in the broth for 3 minutes until pink and opaque.
Blanch the noodles, sprouts and greens, then top with prawns, ribs, eggs and shallots and ladle over the broth.
notes: Food safety: cook the prawns until pink and opaque, cook the pork until tender and at least 75°C, and boil the eggs until set.

recipes.title: Lemang-Style Coconut Sticky Rice Breakfast
recipes.summary: Glutinous rice steamed in coconut milk until sticky and fragrant, served with serundeng and fried egg.
steps: Soak the rice for 2 hours and drain.
Steam the rice over boiling water for 20 minutes until half cooked.
Stir in the coconut milk, water and salt and steam 20 minutes until tender and sticky.
Toast the coconut, peanuts and sugar in a dry pan for 5 minutes until golden.
Fry the eggs in the oil until the whites are fully set.
Serve the rice with serundeng and egg.
notes: Food safety: fry the eggs until the whites and yolks are firm.

recipes.title: Ikan Bakar Style Grilled Fish with Sambal
recipes.summary: Whole-style fish fillets brushed with a turmeric and chilli marinade and grilled until smoky, with a lime sambal.
steps: Mix the chilli paste, turmeric, crushed garlic, tamarind and oil into a marinade.
Rub it over the fish and rest for 20 minutes.
Grill the fish for 4 minutes per side until opaque and flaking.
Dice the tomato, chilli and shallot and toss with lime juice for the sambal.
Serve the fish with the sambal.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and it flakes easily with a fork.

recipes.title: Warm Lamb and Bulgur Salad
recipes.summary: Spiced lamb strips over nutty bulgur with pomegranate, mint and a lemon tahini drizzle.
steps: Soak the bulgur in boiling water for 15 minutes until tender, then drain.
Rub the lamb with cumin, paprika and oil.
Sear the lamb for 4 minutes per side until browned.
Rest the lamb for 5 minutes, then slice.
Whisk tahini, lemon juice and water until pourable.
Toss bulgur with cucumber, rocket and mint, then top with lamb and drizzle.
notes: Food safety: cook lamb to at least 63°C, with the rest time counting, or until no raw meat remains inside if cut.

recipes.title: Chermoula Roasted Carrot Salad
recipes.summary: Sweet roasted carrots in a herb chermoula with chickpeas and almonds.
steps: Roast the carrots with half the oil at 200C for 30 minutes until caramelised.
Blend the herbs, garlic, spices, lemon juice and remaining oil into chermoula.
Toast the almonds until golden and chop.
Toss the warm carrots and chickpeas with the chermoula until coated.
Scatter with the chopped almonds and serve at room temperature.

recipes.title: Warm Potato Salad with Bacon and Mustard
recipes.summary: Waxy potatoes with crisp bacon, red onion and a warm mustard vinaigrette.
steps: Boil the potatoes for 18 minutes until tender, then drain and slice.
Fry the bacon until crisp.
Add the onion and cook for 3 minutes until soft.
Stir in the vinegar, mustard and oil.
Toss with the warm potatoes and parsley.
notes: Food safety: cook the bacon until crisp and fully cooked.

recipes.title: Spiced Pumpkin Seed Granola Clusters
recipes.summary: Crunchy oat clusters with pumpkin seeds, coconut and cinnamon baked until golden.
steps: Whisk the syrup, oil, cinnamon and salt.
Mix with the oats, seeds and coconut.
Fold through the lightly whisked egg white.
Press into a lined tray and pack down firmly with the back of a spoon.
Bake at 150C for 30 minutes until golden.
Cool completely before breaking into clusters.
notes: Food safety: bake until golden and fully dry.

recipes.title: Tortilla Española
recipes.summary: A thick Spanish omelette of slow-cooked potato and onion, set and golden.
steps: Cook the potato and onion in the oil over low heat for 20 minutes until completely soft.
Drain the oil and mix the vegetables into the beaten eggs.
Rest the mixture for 5 minutes until the egg soaks into the potato.
Cook the mixture in a pan for 5 minutes until the base is set and golden.
Flip using a plate and cook for 4 minutes until firm.
notes: Food safety: cook until the egg is fully set in the centre.

recipes.title: Egg and Chorizo Breakfast Burritos
recipes.summary: Warm tortillas filled with scrambled egg, chorizo, beans and salsa.
steps: Fry the chorizo in the oil for 4 minutes until crisp and the fat runs.
Warm the beans in a pot until hot.
Pour in the whisked eggs and scramble until just set.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until soft.
Fill with egg, beans, tomato, salsa and avocado and fold.
notes: Food safety: cook the egg until firm and chorizo until hot throughout.
Wrap in foil to take away.

recipes.title: Congee with Century Egg and Pork
recipes.summary: Silky rice porridge with minced pork, century egg and ginger, a classic Chinese breakfast.
steps: Simmer the rice in the water for 50 minutes, stirring now and then, until the grains burst and the congee turns creamy.
Mix the pork with soy sauce and ginger.
Add the pork and cook for 8 minutes until it reaches 75°C.
Chop the century eggs into small pieces and set aside.
Ladle into bowls and top with egg, spring onion, sesame oil and pepper.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C with no pink.
Century eggs are cured, not cooked, so avoid in pregnancy.

recipes.title: Savoury Oats with Soft Egg and Spinach
recipes.summary: Creamy porridge oats cooked in stock with spinach, topped with a jammy egg and sesame.
steps: Simmer the oats in the stock for 5 minutes until thick and creamy.
Stir in the spinach until wilted.
Boil the egg for 7 minutes until jammy.
Spoon the oats into a bowl and top with the halved egg.
Drizzle with soy sauce and sesame oil and scatter with sesame seeds.
notes: Food safety: a jammy egg is not recommended for pregnant women, older adults or small children, so boil for 10 minutes until firm.

recipes.title: Apple Cinnamon Dutch Porridge Pots
recipes.summary: Creamy porridge baked with apple, cinnamon and a touch of maple, served warm.
steps: Simmer the oats and milk for 5 minutes until thick.
Fold in the apples, cinnamon, syrup and salt.
Spoon into ramekins and bake at 180C for 10 minutes until golden on top.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan Egg Hopper Pancakes
recipes.summary: Bowl-shaped fermented rice pancakes with a lacy edge and a soft egg in the centre.
steps: Mix the flour, coconut milk, water, sugar, yeast and salt until smooth.
Rest in a warm place for 2 hours until bubbly.
Heat a small wok with a little oil until hot.
Pour in a ladle of batter and swirl to coat the sides.
Crack an egg in the centre and cover.
Cook for 3 minutes until the edges are crisp and the egg is set.
notes: Food safety: cook until the egg white is fully set.

recipes.title: Moroccan Spiced Lentil Harira Soup
recipes.summary: A tomato and chickpea soup with lentils, cinnamon and fresh herbs, traditionally eaten to break the Ramadan fast.
steps: Soften the onion and celery in the oil for 6 minutes until translucent.
Add the spices for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes, lentils and stock and simmer for 25 minutes until the lentils are tender.
Stir in the chickpeas and vermicelli and cook for 5 minutes until soft.
Finish with coriander and lemon juice.
notes: Add a pinch of saffron for tradition.

recipes.title: Kale and Quinoa Caesar-Style Bowl
recipes.summary: Massaged kale and quinoa with chicken, a creamy tahini dressing and seeds.
steps: Cook the quinoa for 15 minutes until tender and fluffy.
Season the chicken and pan-fry for 6 minutes per side until it reaches 75°C.
Massage the kale with the oil and lemon juice until softened.
Whisk the tahini, garlic and water into a dressing.
Slice the chicken and arrange over the quinoa and kale.
Drizzle with dressing and seeds.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C and the juices run clear.

recipes.title: Warm Tofu and Peanut Noodle Salad
recipes.summary: Rice vermicelli with crisp tofu, herbs, cucumber and a peanut dressing.
steps: Fry the tofu in the oil for 8 minutes until golden on all sides.
Soak the noodles in boiling water for 5 minutes until tender, then rinse.
Whisk the peanut butter, lime juice, soy sauce, sugar and water until pourable.
Toss the noodles with the vegetables and herbs.
Top with tofu and spoon over the dressing.
notes: Check the noodles are rice for gluten-free.

recipes.title: Caponata Siciliana
recipes.summary: Sweet and sour Sicilian eggplant, celery, olives and capers in a rich tomato sauce.
steps: Fry the eggplant in the oil for 10 minutes until golden, then set aside.
Soften the celery and onion in the same pan for 8 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, olives, capers, vinegar and sugar and simmer for 15 minutes until thick.
Fold in the eggplant and cook for 5 minutes.
Serve at room temperature with basil.

recipes.title: Honey Garlic Roasted Carrots with Thyme
recipes.summary: Glazed carrots roasted until caramelised and sweet.
steps: Halve the carrots lengthways and toss with oil, garlic, thyme and salt.
Roast at 200C for 25 minutes until tender.
Drizzle with honey and roast for 10 minutes until sticky and caramelised.

recipes.title: Colcannon with Cabbage and Spring Onion
recipes.summary: Buttery Irish mash with cabbage and spring onions.
steps: Boil the potatoes for 20 minutes until tender, then drain and mash.
Soften the cabbage in half the butter for 6 minutes until tender.
Warm the milk with the spring onions for 3 minutes.
Beat everything into the mash until smooth and creamy.
Top with the remaining butter.

recipes.title: Spiced Cauliflower Rice Pilaf
recipes.summary: Fluffy grated cauliflower with cumin, raisins, almonds and herbs.
steps: Grate the cauliflower coarsely.
Toast the almonds until golden.
Fry the cauliflower and spices in the oil for 6 minutes until tender and fragrant.
Stir in the raisins and lemon juice.
Top with almonds and parsley.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Wedges with Chipotle Mayo
recipes.summary: Crisp spiced sweet potato wedges with a smoky chipotle mayo.
steps: Cut the sweet potato into wedges and toss with oil and spices.
Roast at 220C for 35 minutes until crisp and browned.
Mix the mayonnaise, chipotle and lime.
Serve the wedges with the dip.

recipes.title: Cheesy Polenta with Roasted Mushrooms
recipes.summary: Creamy polenta with vegetarian hard cheese and garlicky roasted mushrooms.
steps: Roast the mushrooms with oil, garlic and thyme at 200C for 25 minutes until golden.
Whisk the polenta into the simmering water.
Cook for 20 minutes, stirring often, until thick and creamy.
Stir in the butter and cheese.
Spoon the mushrooms over the polenta.
notes: Vegetarian when made with vegetarian hard cheese.
Add milk to loosen if it sets.

recipes.title: Fermented Chilli Hot Sauce
recipes.summary: A tangy, funky hot sauce from chillies fermented in brine for a week.
steps: Dissolve the salt in the water.
Pack the chopped chillies and garlic into a jar and cover with the brine.
Weigh down and ferment at room temperature for 7 days until bubbly and sour.
Drain, reserving the brine.
Blend with the vinegar, sugar and enough brine until smooth.
notes: Discard if it smells off or grows fuzzy mould.

recipes.title: Chilli Crisp Oil
recipes.summary: A crunchy chilli oil with garlic, shallots and sesame, for noodles and dumplings.
steps: Slice the garlic and shallots thinly.
Heat the oil with the star anise to 120C.
Fry the garlic and shallots in the oil for 6 minutes until golden and crisp.
Pour the hot oil over the chilli flakes and sesame in a heatproof bowl.
Stir in the soy sauce and sugar once cooled.
notes: Keep it in the fridge for 1 month.

recipes.title: Garlic Toum Whipped Sauce
recipes.summary: A fluffy Lebanese garlic emulsion of garlic, oil and lemon, no egg.
steps: Blend the garlic and salt to a paste.
Add oil a few drops at a time while blending.
Alternate with lemon juice and ice water until thick and white.
Rest in the fridge for 1 hour.
notes: Add the oil slowly or it splits.

recipes.title: Teriyaki Glaze
recipes.summary: A glossy homemade teriyaki sauce of soy, mirin and sugar.
steps: Simmer the soy sauce, mirin, sugar, ginger and garlic for 5 minutes.
Whisk the cornflour with water and stir in until glossy and thick.
Strain the glaze and cool it until it thickens further.
